title: What In-Context Learning “Learns” In-Context: Disentangling Task Recognition and Task Learning
method_paraphrase: Task recognition uses pretrained task priors; task learning captures new input-label mappings. Their classification experiments distinguish these mechanisms.
research_boundary: Useful conceptual distinction; does not by itself establish either mechanism in robot control.

title: Instant Policy: In-Context Imitation Learning via Graph Diffusion
method_paraphrase: Instant Policy learns in-context imitation from one or two demonstrations using graph representations and diffusion.
research_boundary: Demonstration-conditioned skill acquisition is legitimate ICL; it need not require multiple self-attempts.

title: In-Context Imitation Learning via Next-Token Prediction
method_paraphrase: ICRT predicts actions from sensorimotor demonstrations and current observations without test-time policy parameter updates.
research_boundary: Demonstration prompting does not establish learning from the robot's own failed attempts.

title: RL²: Fast Reinforcement Learning via Slow Reinforcement Learning
method_paraphrase: RL2 uses a recurrent state across episodes of an unseen task; slow training learns a fast adaptation procedure from observations, actions, rewards and termination flags.
research_boundary: Fast and slow learning are established ideas; this is not a robotics-specific verification system.

title: In-context Reinforcement Learning with Algorithm Distillation
publication_status: arXiv, v1; official ICLR 2023 PDF also located
method_paraphrase: Algorithm Distillation trains a causal sequence model on reinforcement-learning histories across episodes, enabling adaptation in context without network parameter updates.
research_boundary: Learning-history distillation must be a strong baseline rather than claimed as our invention.

title: Vintix II: Decision Pre-Trained Transformer is a Scalable In-Context Reinforcement Learner
method_paraphrase: Vintix II scales Decision Pre-Trained Transformer in-context reinforcement learning across diverse domains with flow matching.
research_boundary: A generalist robot learning claim must address existing cross-domain ICRL, not compare only against BC.

title: Zeva: In-Context Causal Learning for Generalizable Embodied Manipulation
locator: Sections III-A, III-C, III-D and III-F
method_paraphrase: Zeva encodes action-effect experience into within-attempt and across-attempt memories while all model parameters remain frozen during deployment.
research_boundary: Own-interaction memory adaptation already has a robot precedent. Persistent interaction memory here resets for a new episode; cumulative retry success is not alone proof of learning.

title: Flux-OPD: On-Policy Distillation with Evolving Contexts
method_paraphrase: Flux-OPD distills evolving contextual supervision using a context-free teacher anchor and conflict-dependent contextual corrections.
research_boundary: Its reported domains are open-ended language tasks; it already constrains any novelty claim based only on evolving teacher contexts.

title: RE-0: Verified Recursive Improvement of Embodied Code-as-Policy Agents through Local On-Policy Distillation
locator: Abstract; Section 1 local counterfactual credit and RE-OPD
method_paraphrase: RE-0 checks bounded teacher corrections on student failure histories with paired execution; verified intervention benefit weights subsequent student distillation.
research_boundary: Verified correction plus OPD is a direct overlap. The candidate must test future adaptation utility separately from current completion benefit.

title: Recursive Video In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot
method_paraphrase: Recursive Video ICL exposes a demonstration hierarchy through read-only tools for planning and execution by an agent around a frozen VLA.
research_boundary: Recursive denotes hierarchical access here, not recursive weight improvement or autonomous learning of unknown rules.

title: In-context Robot Learning Made Simple: A Democratized Recipe for Manipulation Tasks
method_paraphrase: SimpleICL studies ambiguity in the information supplied by visual demonstrations and designs a visual prompt encoder and data protocol.
research_boundary: A benchmark must specify what the prompt supplies and what new mapping the student must infer.

title: A Reduction of Imitation Learning and Structured Prediction to No-Regret Online Learning
author_citation: Ross, S., Gordon, G. and Bagnell, D.
method_paraphrase: DAgger addresses policy-induced observation distributions by iterative expert-supervised data aggregation.
research_boundary: Student-state expert labeling is established imitation learning; it does not alone identify an ICL mechanism.

title: Learning to Learn Faster from Human Feedback with Language Model Predictive Control
reading_depth: Primary abstract and author method summary
method_paraphrase: LMPC trains on robot teaching interaction histories; its slow finetuning improves fast in-context learning of unseen tasks from human feedback.
research_boundary: Even improved teachability on new tasks is prior art. Autonomous physical feedback and explicit utility estimation require separate evidence.

title: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies
locator: Author project Sequence Training and Effective Learning from Context
method_paraphrase: RoboTTT uses fast-weight recurrent state for long context. In DAgger distillation, suboptimal actions supply context while human corrections supply targets.
research_boundary: Failure-as-context and correction-as-target are not new. Fast-weight updates should be distinguished from fixed-weight ICL and durable slow-weight consolidation.

title: RoboHarn-Evo: Evolving Hierarchical Physical Knowledge for Self-Improving Robotic Manipulation
method_paraphrase: RoboHarn-Evo verifies physical feedback to revise task and action knowledge in a dual-loop harness with the base VLM and executor fixed.
research_boundary: Verified knowledge maintenance and external-memory transfer already exist; their benefits do not by themselves establish weight absorption.

title: Sample-Efficient Learning from Agent Experience
locator: Abstract; method section headings and scope
method_paraphrase: Experience Distillation internalizes trial-and-error interaction context into weights using collected experience, evaluated on software and text-adventure tasks.
research_boundary: Experience absorption is not a new concept. We have not reproduced its method or compared its performance in robotics.

title: Decoupling Exploration and Exploitation for Meta-Reinforcement Learning without Sacrifices
reading_depth: Official paper introduction and abstract; original Cooking/Grid/InstructionWrapper source at pinned revision
method_paraphrase: Separate task-relevant exploration and exploitation objectives. Experiments include hidden ingredient mappings in the Cooking grid.
research_boundary: Learning to identify task-relevant information is already central to DREAM; this diagnostic does not retrain DREAM.

title: What is intrinsic motivation? A typology of computational approaches
method_paraphrase: Intrinsic learning incentives distinguish information and learning-related objectives from external task reward.
research_boundary: The learning-value/current-reward distinction cannot be claimed as new.
